findings.text: polished_nearest is recomputed from display.saddle_rz, the value the code under test chose, so the assertion cannot fail if the code measured to a wrong saddle; only the sibling abs(polished_nearest - seed_nearest) > 1.0e-12 line at :306 distinguishes the seed from the polished point, and an independent polish_stationary_points call on the map would pin the done_when's 'polished saddle, not the seed' claim.

the offset is taken from display.saddle_rz, the code's own output, so reverting the distance to any point the code also reports would keep the assertion green; it guards only the seed regression that tests/test_coil_edit_panel_render.py:306 already covers.

display.promoted_node_count is compared with np.count_nonzero of the same persisted mask handed to the map, so both sides move together and the assertion can only catch a truncation disagreement, never a wrong promoted count.

promoted_nodes[:node_count] silently discards the mask's entries past the lattice node prefix (the converged archive carries 60 nonzeros, of which 46 fall in the prefix) with no assertion that the discarded entries are the non-lattice tail rather than lattice nodes, so a mask ordered differently would under-report promoted_node_count without any check.
